haiku.problem: The setup says the LORD spoke of His vineyard as His people's land. The verses call it 'My vineyard' and 'My plot of ground' and never say it is the people's land, so the setup adds a fact not in the verses.

The setup drops the 'if' from verse 16. The LORD says the neighbors will be established only if they diligently learn the ways of His people and swear by His name. The question presents learning and swearing as things they would do, which misstates the condition.
